dataJoin.decisionSpine: Frozen Binance contract 1h bars inherited from MIE1.
dataJoin.positioning: Exact decision-time match to the checksum-verified MIE2 hourly positioning snapshot. metric_time must be non-null and <= decisionTime.
dataJoin.premium: Exact signal-bar timestamp premium-index close inherited from MIE1.
dataJoin.funding: Latest realized funding event timestamp <= decisionTime; trade cashflow uses only realized funding events while position is open.

splitPurity.fit: Signal time, next-open entry and full 24-bar maximum holding horizon must all remain strictly before 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
splitPurity.development: Signal time, next-open entry and full 24-bar maximum holding horizon must all remain strictly before 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.

executionParity: LONG and SHORT outcomes are simulated by the same frozen rules as MIE1: next 1h open, stop at 1 signal ATR, TP2 at 1.5R, 24 evaluated bars, stop-first same-bar, inherited base/stress friction, realized funding.

positioningFeatureSemantics.oiContractsZ24h: Current OI contracts standardized against previous 24 completed hourly snapshots only.
positioningFeatureSemantics.oiValueZ24h: Current OI value standardized against previous 24 completed hourly snapshots only.
positioningFeatureSemantics.ratioDeltas: Current corresponding log-ratio minus its exact lag at 1/3/6/24 hours as named.
positioningFeatureSemantics.priceReturns: Contract close/lagged close - 1 at 1/3/6/12/24 hours using the completed signal bar.
positioningFeatureSemantics.premiumClose: Premium-index close from completed signal bar.
positioningFeatureSemantics.latestFundingRate: Latest realized funding rate available at decisionTime.

pairwiseTarget.targetSpreadR: base-cost-and-funding LONG netR minus base-cost-and-funding SHORT netR.
pairwiseTarget.longBetter: 1 if targetSpreadR >0; 0 if <0; exact zero ties excluded from pairwise classifier/regressor fitting.
pairwiseTarget.pairDirectionAccuracy: Chosen base netR >= opposite base netR; exact outcome ties count correct.

preprocessing.numeric: MedianImputer -> StandardScaler; fitted on fit only.

modelImplementation.longBetterLogit: LogisticRegression solver=lbfgs exactly as parent lock.
modelImplementation.longBetterHgb: HistGradientBoostingClassifier loss=log_loss, early_stopping=false exactly as parent lock.
modelImplementation.spreadHgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor loss=squared_error, early_stopping=false exactly as parent lock.
modelImplementation.tradableHgb: HistGradientBoostingClassifier loss=log_loss, early_stopping=false exactly as parent lock.

scoring.selection: At each entry timestamp rank all eligible symbol-hours by strength descending, tie symbol ascending; choose exactly top 2.

baselineAndUtility.selectedDeltaVsPairMean: chosenNetR - pairMean for each selected symbol-hour.
baselineAndUtility.portfolioClockBaseline: Mean pairMean across all eligible development symbol-hours.
baselineAndUtility.absoluteProfitabilityMandatory: Positive relative selection is insufficient if absolute expectancy/stress/PF gates fail.

opportunityAudit.allEligibleDirectionalGood: Count both LONG and SHORT frozen goodOpportunity labels across every eligible development symbol-hour.
opportunityAudit.selectedGood: GoodOpportunity of the model-chosen direction for selected symbol-hours.

bootstrap.samplingUnit: For each symbol, chronological symbol-hour rows are circularly resampled in 24-hour blocks with replacement.
bootstrap.absolute: Mean chosen netR among sampled rows whose original selected flag is true.
bootstrap.relative: Mean chosen-minus-pairMean among sampled selected rows.

governance: No May-2026 onward access unless every development gate passes.
MIE2 failure activates terminal research stop for this closure project.
